notes: Paired control/flawed recipes and synthetic telemetry are executable in tests/review/fixtures/pilot-cases.ts. They test detector sensitivity only; no live Studio captures, AI reviewer results, or rendered-quality measurements are included.

cases.intent: Gentle chest breathing with a continuous loop and stationary feet.
cases.verification: Confirm smooth world-space torso motion near the loop boundary and fixed foot contacts.

cases.intent: Same breathing motion and planted contacts as idle-control.
cases.injection: Insert an UpperTorso key at 1.966666667 seconds offset by 25 degrees about local X from the smooth control pose, retaining the matching keys at 0 and 2 seconds.
cases.expectedDefect: A rapid torso snap immediately before loop closure, despite equal endpoint transforms.
cases.verification: Measure relative torso rotation changes over the last 30 Hz samples; corroborate with the side frames. Sparse images alone cannot establish full velocity.

cases.intent: A grounded run cycle with the left sole planted from 0.1 to 0.3 seconds.
cases.verification: Construct and verify a stationary world-space left sole point during the declared interval before admitting the control.

cases.intent: Same declared left sole contact interval as run-control.
cases.injection: Alter evaluated left foot motion to accumulate 0.4 studs of horizontal world-space displacement from 0.1 to 0.3 seconds while preserving vertical contact height and loop endpoints.
cases.expectedDefect: The left sole slides during its explicitly planted interval.
cases.verification: Confirm 0.4 studs of displacement from the recorded contact point, using a ground reference in both camera views. Local joint translation is not itself the world-space ground truth.

cases.intent: Breathing in a two-handed sword guard with both hands meeting separate sword grip targets.
cases.verification: Measure both hand contact-to-grip distances throughout the clip and establish a rig-specific control tolerance.

cases.intent: Same two-handed grip requirement as guard-control.
cases.injection: Move the off-hand contact to create 0.5 studs of separation from its sword grip target at 1.6 seconds, blending from and back to the unchanged endpoint pose.
cases.expectedDefect: The off hand releases the required grip during the breathing motion.
cases.verification: Confirm contact-to-target distance in evaluated world transforms and frame the gap visibly in at least one view.
